items.name: cat-sheet
items.prompt: a character sheet of six chibi cat villagers arranged in an even 3x2 grid with wide spacing: a plump baker cat holding a bread basket, a thin fisher cat with a fishing rod, a farmer cat in a straw hat holding a hoe, a scholar cat reading a book, a sturdy blacksmith cat with apron and hammer, a cheerful innkeeper cat holding a mug; simple cloth villager outfits, no magic, no staffs, varied plump and thin body shapes, clean black ink line art, plain white background, generous space between characters
